root_identity: Every score row and receipt carries the explicit mosaic root; a run-specific overlay is authenticated by URI and SHA-256 in every READY manifest.

positive_controls.additive: held-out people must recover an event-value main effect above the same-capacity zero-event negative
positive_controls.interaction: held-out people must recover a nearby-event XOR effect that neither single-event marginal identifies
positive_controls.negative: F0, value-disabled, label-permuted, and zero/one/two-event controls must not reproduce the held-out positive gain

training.calendar: marker shards are derived only from TRAIN people and shared byte-for-byte across all five arms
training.sample_disjunction: FIT and VALID sample_key_sha256 sets must have empty intersection

promotion.parameter_basis: strictly positive implements the existing positive-increment gate; zero log-loss increase implements non-worsening; no empirical effect-size threshold is introduced
requires: RE F1 must exceed F0, RD, POOLED, SHAM and GEOMETRY
RE log-loss must be nonworse than every comparator
replication: all five 95CI lower bounds positive across at least three roots
promotion.triage_rule: R0-only may advance to expansion by paired point-estimate gate; it cannot claim replication or open VALID

metric_collection: Promotion consumes only the complete metric collection produced from authenticated M37_TRACE_SCORE artifact/receipt pairs; manually supplied metric JSON is forbidden.
marker_axis: marker_pos and marker_cM must either be carried together or be bound by the joint upstream M34 F0 receipt; the ordered physical/genetic pairs are then hashed before materialization
